softpkg.name: MANET_Node
softpkg.title: MANET_Node
softpkg.description: SCA 2.2.2 CF::Resource wrapping the assembled MANET control/data-plane node (hh_node_t, include/hhsdr/manet/node.h) from the hh-sdr-manet C implementation. Adapts the existing SCA-shaped lifecycle/property/port content basis already present in src/sca/resource.c to the CF::LifeCycle, CF::TestableObject, CF::PropertySet, CF::PortSupplier, and CF::Resource interfaces defined in SCA 2.2.2 Appendix C. Contains no CORBA/ORB binding, no DomainManager/DeviceManager/ApplicationFactory dependency, and no REDHAWK-specific API usage -- see MANET_Node.scd.xml and adapter/manet_sca_adapter.h for the exact interface surface implemented and docs/SCA-COMPATIBILITY.md for the full list of what is deliberately not implemented at this phase.

implementation.description: Reference (non-CORBA) implementation: a plain-C adapter layer (adapter/manet_sca_adapter.c) that translates SCA CF interface operations (initialize/releaseObject/configure/query/runTest/getPort/ start/stop) onto the existing hh_node_t lifecycle and hh_sca_resource_t lifecycle guard (src/sca/resource.c), then delegates all MANET behavior to the unmodified production code in libhhsdr_core.a. No ORB skeleton/stub code is generated or linked in this phase; wiring this adapter to a live CF::Resource CORBA servant is future work explicitly out of scope here (see README.md in this directory).
